Scope desktop presence subscriptions to active demand

entries.title: Polish mobile profiles, DMs, and sheets
entries.rationale: Accepted as a broad mobile UX and query-efficiency change, queued because it changes addressed-event filtering, DM/profile surfaces, and relay query fallback behavior that must be checked against Zion privacy and protocol contracts.
security_reasons: activity results are newly filtered by addressed-to-me and DM membership predicates
profile-owner and agent identity data are reused across message/profile surfaces
batched relay query with WebSocket fallback changes event visibility and transport behavior

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after mobile privacy/query review, addressed-event regression tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and mobile gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, addressed-event filtering, profile/DM surfaces, relay query fallback, changed mobile tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.

entries.title: Scope desktop presence subscriptions to active demand
entries.rationale: Accepted as privacy-positive subscription scoping, queued for adaptation with tests proving active-query demand, replacement ordering, retry, and cleanup behavior.
security_reasons: presence subscriptions are reduced to pubkeys requested by active observers
subscription replacement and reconnect handling must not leak stale presence demand
query-key normalization must preserve tenant/account boundaries

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after presence privacy/subscription review, focused reconciler tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, active-demand filtering and subscription reconciler tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
